name: UpdateOpacityTransferFunction
aliases: TransferFunction GPU Upload with DDA Check
definition: Allocates GPU memory and loads the opacity transfer function table, or reloads it if the transfer function changed.
summary: UpdateOpacityTransferFunction allocates GPU memory, enforces monotonic opacity for DDA optimizations, and uploads the transfer function to an SSBO, distinguishing itself from file I/O by focusing on GPU upload and uniform binding.
